Before I answer, I need to fix my last message: the policy does cover this. With no tracking movement for 4 business days, we open a courier investigation (up to 5 business days). If the package is lost, you choose a free replacement or a full refund. The refund timeframes I quoted aren't in my policy information, so please disregard them. I'm sorry for the back-and-forth.

I can't confirm that the replacement would ship Express. The policy doesn't say what shipping method a lost-package replacement gets. Regular Express is $14.95, is never free, and isn't available to Zone 3 addresses. If your replacement is a live plant, it would also ship Monday-Wednesday only.

Please send your order number (LF- plus six digits) so I can open the investigation. If you'd like, I can also escalate to a Support Lead to confirm the shipping method for your replacement.
